note: Residents without a backstory are not degraded, only thinner: they reason from their bare record. A store that covers the cohort is sufficient for a run whose cohort it covers, and is not a claim about the rest of the town.  Bedok is the portability proof: it runs the whole deterministic engine on its own network, and is deliberately not deliberated, because that would cost as much again as the primary town and show nothing the primary town has not already shown.
scope: backstories + deterministic engine; no deliberation, by choice
